code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia (with neutropenia and lymphopenia), thrombocytopenia, low serum protein, elevated CRP, ferritin, and INR, and mild basophilia. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection, and bone marrow suppression or dysfunction. The elevated ferritin and CRP may indicate an acute phase response. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation for underlying causes (e.g., severe infection, sepsis, or hematologic disorder) are recommended.
